title: Schur number S(9), lower bound
statement: Colour 1, 2, ..., n with 9 colours so that no colour holds a solution of x + y = z (x = y allowed), with n as large as possible; it shows S(9) >= n. The best known lower bound is S(9) >= 17803, by Ageron, Casteras, Pellerin, Portella, Rimmel and Tomasik (2021); a colouring of 1..17804 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the colours of 1..n in order, digits 0..8 (whitespace ignored).
score: n, the length of the colouring; it proves S(9) >= n (larger is better)

best_known.source: S(9) >= 17803: Ageron, Casteras, Pellerin, Portella, Rimmel and Tomasik (2021), in Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit 4521e13 (8 Nov 2026); read 8 Nov 2026
